title: The assistant features editor program, nine years on
content: Early in 2017, Plant Physiology and The Plant Cell initiated a new program to provide opportunities for early-career scientists called the Assistant Features Editor (AFE) program. The goal of this program is to support career advancement of early-career plant scientists by providing them with editorial board experience and the opportunity to fine-tune their writing skills. Assistant Features Editors receive formal writing training as well as careful, formative feedback on their drafts by members of the editorial board (as well as other AFEs) as a mentored skill-building activity. Not only do the AFEs gain writing experience and professional exposure, but their summaries bring visibility and accessibility to the highlighted research articles. Additionally, the AFEs are invited to participate in editorial board meetings to get a closer look at how these important bodies function. Several former AFEs have now been invited to serve on the editorial boards in other official capacities.
